ppl.title: PPL in three lines
lines: PPL is the token of the PEOPLE network.
Its price follows a formula published in advance: it rises as PPL sells and falls when PPL is sold back.
PEOPLE does not set or raise the price. Nobody moves it by hand.
ppl.chartAria: PPL price by the published formula: {start} at the start, {end} when the curve closes
ppl.details: This is a bonding curve: price = {start} × e^(k·x), where x is millions of PPL sold and k = ln(50)/100. Each purchase moves the price up the curve, each sell-back moves it down. {supply} PPL are on the curve. It closes once {graduation} has been raised (at about {end} per PPL) or {term} after opening, whichever comes first.

rules.title: Same rules for everyone
rules.lead: They are fixed in the sale contract. Nobody can change the limits or the formula.

items.title: First {whitelistDays} days: verified people only
items.body: One person, one address. From {min} to {max} per purchase, up to {perDay} per address per day (UTC), and a {cooldown}-second pause between purchases.

items.title: {reservePct} of every purchase stays as a reserve
items.body: It stays in the sale contract to pay for sell-backs. Nobody on the team can withdraw it. The other {treasuryPct} funds the project.

items.title: Sell back after {holdDays} days
items.body: Each purchase can be sold back {holdDays} days after it was made, at the curve price at that moment. Per day: up to {sellDailyPct} of the reserve for all sellers together and up to {sellPerAddress} per address. Fee {feeLow}; {feeHigh} on the part above {feeThreshold} of the reserve that day. Verified people only.

items.title: Open for anyone to check
items.body: The sale contract is public, and every purchase in it can be checked. Project money is held in a wallet where every payment needs {signersM} of {signersN} signatures.

rules.auditLine: Reviewed by AI models: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT Astra, Fable 5.1 (run by the project team). This is not a security audit. No external audit has been done yet.
rules.auditBounty: Found a vulnerability? Report it with the bug button on any page.
details: Reserve: the USDC kept in the sale contract. Sell-backs are paid from it, and sell-back fees stay in it. The smaller the reserve, the smaller the daily sell-back limit. Sell-back closes for good once the curve closes.
The reserve leaves the contract only as PPL liquidity, when the curve closes, and only after a public notice of {releaseDays} days. Sell-back keeps working during the notice.
Treasury: a multisig wallet ({signersM} of {signersN} signatures) that receives the other {treasuryPct} of each purchase.
The multisig can pause buying and sell-back. It cannot move the reserve, change the limits or the formula, or extend the sale.
The sale runs until {graduation} has been raised or for {term} after opening, whichever comes first. Unsold PPL goes to the Community Pool. Purchases are final.
Team: {teamPct} of all PPL. Nothing for the first {cliff}, then monthly over {linear}, counted from the full network launch.

faq.title: Short answers

items.a: So that every buyer is a real person. One person gets one address, and the limits apply to people, not bots. The first {whitelistDays} days are for verified people only. Verify with World ID or Human Passport; Telegram alone is not enough. No personal data is written to the blockchain.

items.q: When can I send PPL to other people?
items.a: PPL is credited on the PEOPLE network right after your purchase. At first the network only receives PPL: transfers between participants open later, once there are about 1,000 verified participants. Until then you can sell PPL back to the reserve under the rules above.

items.q: Which networks can I pay from?
items.a: On Base: USDC, or USDT, which is swapped to USDC automatically for a small fee. From other networks the payment is swapped automatically: EVM networks (Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche and others), Tron and Solana. TON is not supported. The purchase itself always goes through in USDC on Base.

items.q: How much can be sold back today?
items.a: Each purchase can be sold back {holdDays} days after it was made. Each day, up to {sellDailyPct} of the reserve can be sold back by all sellers together, and up to {sellPerAddress} per address. A small reserve means a small daily limit. Today's figure is shown in the rules above.
No. Every purchase is final. The only way back is selling to the reserve, under the rules above.

faq.riskBody: PPL can lose value. Buy only what you can afford to risk. Follow the laws of your country.

finalCta.bounty: or earn PPL by completing tasks

notes.text: PPL is the utility token of the PEOPLE network. During the sale its price follows the published formula; after that the market sets it, and it can fall as well as rise. PPL is not a security, not a share in a company, not a deposit and not an investment product. No profit, yield or return of any kind is promised or guaranteed. Figures shown before a purchase are estimates; the exact amounts are confirmed on-chain before you sign. Nothing on this page is investment, legal or tax advice.
Participation may be restricted or unavailable where you live, and checking the rules that apply to you is your own responsibility. Use only money you can afford to lose.

The AI-assisted reviews named above were run by the project team. They are not a security audit, and no external audit has been done yet. A bug bounty reduces risk but does not remove it: no review can prove software free of defects.

form.riskMore: Also: PPL transfers between participants open later, once the PEOPLE network has about 1,000 verified participants. Selling back to the reserve is for verified users only, 30 days after each purchase and within daily limits. The sale contract has been reviewed only by AI models; no external audit has been done yet. The project multisig can pause buying and selling back.
form.saleTermsNote: The sale runs until it sells out (the curve closes at $4M raised) or for 24 months from opening, whichever comes first. No extensions. Unsold PPL goes to the Community Pool. No refunds: every purchase is final.
form.termsAgree: By buying you agree to the {terms}.
form.noWalletHint: No wallet? Choose Google or email — a PEOPLE Wallet is created for you. To pay, you need USDC on Base in that wallet or in a wallet you connect.
form.sellBackTerms: Sell-back to the reserve — verified users only. Each purchase can be sold back 30 days after it was made, at the curve price at the moment you sell. Daily limits: 2% of the reserve for everyone together and $2,000 per address. Fee: 1.5%; 3% only on the part of the day's sell-backs above 1% of the reserve. Closes when the curve closes. Payouts in USDC on Base.
form.feesBody: Fees: the Base network fee (gas), paid in ETH — usually about $0.01; the LI.FI swap or bridge fee — shown in the widget before you confirm; the sell-back fee — 1.5%, and 3% only on the part of the day's sell-backs above 1% of the reserve.
form.timingBody: A purchase on Base is confirmed within seconds. Payments from other networks usually arrive within 1–20 minutes. Sell-back payouts are made in USDC on Base.
form.getUsdc: No USDC yet? Buy it on an exchange and withdraw it to the Base network, or pay from another network below. You also need a little ETH on Base for fees.
form.glossaryBase: Base is a low-fee network built on Ethereum. USDC and USDT are stablecoins pegged to the US dollar. LI.FI is the service that swaps tokens and moves them between networks.
form.phishing: The only official sale address is shown on this page. PEOPLE never asks for your seed phrase and never sends payment links in direct messages.
form.payFromNetworks: Works from EVM networks (Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche and others), Tron and Solana. TON is not supported.
form.bridgeSteps: Step 1. Swap your tokens to USDC on Base in the widget (usually 1–20 minutes). Step 2. Buy PPL with the button below.
form.solanaHint: Paying from Solana or Tron? You also need an address on Base to receive USDC: connect MetaMask, Trust Wallet or WalletConnect, or sign in with Google.
